title: Align Idea Lab with Main Happy Path V1
description: Make Idea Lab generate the six candidates required by Main Happy Path V1 and keep validation, prompt, and UI copy aligned.
businessContext: The current Idea Lab still enforces the deferred twelve-candidate 4/4/4 contract, which contradicts the accepted V1 path and can block the next stage contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Idea Lab requests and validates exactly six candidates.
The six candidates include two low-risk, two medium-risk, and two high-risk candidates with unique IDs.
The local candidate generator, provider adapter prompt, tests, and UI copy use the same six-candidate contract.
No downstream stage behavior or automatic approval is changed.
humanEscalationConditions: The accepted Main Happy Path specification changes the candidate count or distribution.
